sources.title: Language Technologies Research Centre, IIIT Hyderabad
sources.snippet: Anusaaraka is a machine translation tool being developed by the Chinmaya International Foundation (CIF), International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIIT-H) and University of Hyderabad (Department of Sanskrit Studies). Fusion of traditional Indian shastras and advanced modern technologies is what Anusaaraka is all about.
